title: Variation Brownian Kernel Ladders
abstract: arXiv:2608.13882v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Claims about the benefit of depth depend on the complexity assigned to a representation. We introduce the \emph{Variation Brownian Kernel Ladder} (VBKL), a path-atomic function-space framework that separates nonlinear recursive dictionary construction from linear variation superposition. Starting from linear projections, each atom recursively composes unit-ball profiles from the Brownian reproducing kernel Hilbert space; the full VBKL space is then the signed-measure variation hull of the completed dictionary. We identify each recursive dictionary as a union of Brownian pullback RKHS balls and establish variation-controlled H\"older regularity, compactness and attainment, and strict growth with depth under a local non-degeneracy condition whose trace lies in the support of the input measure. For associated finite lower-support architectures, we derive Rademacher and generalization bounds through Brownian quadratic chaos, signed threshold

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13882v1 公告类型：新 摘要：关于深度益处的论断取决于分配给表示的复杂度。我们引入了“变分布朗核阶梯”（VBKL），这是一种路径原子函数空间框架，它将非线性递归字典构建与线性变分叠加分离。从线性投影开始，每个原子递归地组合来自布朗再生核希尔伯特空间的单位球轮廓；完整的VBKL空间则是完成字典的符号测度变分包络。我们将每个递归字典识别为布朗拉回RKHS球的并集，并建立了变分控制的Hölder正则性、紧致性和可达性，以及在局部非退化条件下随深度的严格增长，其迹位于输入测度的支撑内。对于相关的有限低支撑架构，我们通过布朗二次混沌、符号阈值导出了Rademacher和泛化界。
tldr: 本文提出了变分布朗核阶梯（VBKL）框架，通过分离递归字典构建与线性变分叠加，证明了深度增长带来的表示复杂度提升，并给出了泛化理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Variation Brownian Kernel Ladder (VBKL) framework, which separates recursive dictionary construction from linear variation superposition, proving that depth increases representation complexity with generalization guarantees.
